P01.rationale: There is no founder portrait on this page; the layout relies entirely on typography and a large graphic numeral.

P05.rationale: The client name appears as small text within the dark panel rather than as a framed portrait at meaningful size.

P07.rationale: A quote block is present in the bottom right of the dark panel, serving as a minimal form of social proof.

P10.rationale: The page features a massive '02' numeral and large typography that acts as oversized decorative elements.

P11.rationale: There are no data visualizations or charts; the layout is purely typographic with text blocks.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet without sparse gaps.

P13.rationale: The background is a flat, solid off-white color with no intentional texture or atmosphere applied.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos on this page to evaluate for treatment or readability of overlaid text.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockups are shown; the design consists only of typography and a solid color block.

N07.rationale: The imagery is non-existent (typographic only), so it cannot be classified as generic stock photography.

N08.rationale: There are no large empty regions of dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with content.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on busy photos without a scrim because there are no photographs present to cause this issue.
